content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm seeking some assistance due to my limited experience. I have a [article_no] with firmware version [version_no]. I’m trying to understand if there are hardware differences between FS04 and FS05/FS06, and whether updating the firmware on FS04 is possible. I’ve updated my [product_name] software from [version_no] to [version_no], which works fine, but I’m unsure if I’m missing features due to the hardware version. Any guidance would be very helpful.

The [product_name] with [article_no] and firmware [version_no] corresponds to the current [product_name] hardware revision [version_no], not an FS04 model. It’s listed as a [product_name] [version_no] in the hardware selection. The upcoming [product_name] [version_no], identified by [article_no] and firmware [version_no], will appear as [product_name] [version_no] in hardware selection.

Thank you for the clarification. So, just to confirm, there is no added programming functionality or capability when moving from [product_name] software [version_no] to [version_no] unless the hardware is updated. Is that correct?

That’s not quite accurate. The upcoming [product_name] [version_no] does introduce new features. However, the firmware of a [product_name] [version_no] cannot be updated to match the firmware of [product_name] [version_no]. For more details, see the topic on new features in [product_name] [version_no].

To clarify, the upcoming [product_name] [version_no] will have new features. The firmware from [product_name] [version_no] cannot be upgraded to [product_name] [version_no]. I previously mentioned ‘update the hardware,’ but I should have said ‘replace the hardware.’ Updating just the [product_name] software from [version_no] to [version_no] provides no benefit unless you also replace the hardware module (e.g., from [article_no] to [article_no]). Can you explain what the FS04 code means? Regardless, I plan to replace the module once the new release is available.
For further information, check the topic discussing firmware version codes (FS:0x).

analysis.insight_summary: The conversation centers on uncertainty regarding hardware and firmware compatibility among different hardware revisions of [product_name], as well as the impact of updating [product_name] software alone versus replacing hardware modules. There are knowledge gaps around hardware version codes, firmware constraints, and the requirements to access features introduced in [product_name] [version_no].
